request.prompt:
Create exactly ONE isolated, full-body production prototype for Mass Effect — Armax Relay Clash, faithfully reproducing the specific original game model in the attached reference. Detailed realistic game-render finish and crisp readable silhouette, neutral studio illumination. Preserve the actual model proportions, surface materials, colors, equipment, anatomy and side-specific asymmetry. One subject and one view only; the reference sheet must not appear in the output. Keep all body parts and tips entirely inside the image with at least 6 percent transparent padding all around. Transparent RGBA background, no ground, no scene, no floor shadow, no text, no captions or logos. No redesign, no added equipment or invented effects. This is a static illustration, not an animation sheet.

Subject: standard Remnant Observer from Mass Effect: Andromeda, the mechanical hovering drone in these two BioWare artist references. Use the FIRST image as the pose and silhouette authority, and the SECOND only to clarify mechanical details. Preserve the dark gunmetal/gray irregular angular carapace around its broad flattened head, the separated plate shapes and visible internal blue cable lattice, restrained blue luminous optical nodes, the two broad long bowed segmented ribbon-like lower appendages, and the thinner hanging cables with small blue luminous tips. Match the actual number and attachment points of the visible appendages from the first image, including the smallest delicate tips. Do not turn it into a rounded jellyfish or symmetrical generic robot. Keep the complete head and all cable tips fully within the canvas. Static hovering three-quarter pose, no laser beam, no lens flare, no atmospheric particles, no red or green variant.
